evals.prompt: My skills are a mess — Claude shows duplicates and Codex stopped loading one of them. Get my skills back in order.
evals.expected_output: Runs skillctl audit, then sync --plan, reviews actions, applies sync (archiving strays, never deleting), finishes with verify and the per-provider ok/fixed/archived/attention report.

evals.prompt: The caveman repo got new commits upstream. Update my local caveman skills and make sure nothing breaks in Kimi.
evals.expected_output: Runs skillctl update --skill caveman in plan mode, then --apply (archiving the old canonical into _archive), records the new commit in the upstream cache, and ends with verify.

evals.prompt: I dropped a random folder into ~/.agents/skills and now I'm not sure what's installed where. Audit my skill setup but don't delete anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs skillctl audit, reports the stray, explains it would be moved to _archive/<date>/ by sync --apply, and does not hard-delete anything.

evals.prompt: Write a new SKILL.md for my custom linter skill.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger skill-doctor; this is skill authoring, not cross-provider install repair (skill-creator or tri-client-skill-port territory).
